title: Portfolio Website
tagline: A modern, responsive portfolio website built with React and TypeScript
overview: This is my personal portfolio site, showcasing my projects, blog posts, and professional background. Built from scratch with a focus on performance and design.
problem: No centralized place to showcase my work in a performant and visually appealing manner.
solution: Built a static React site with Tailwind and Vite that loads quickly and is easily maintainable.
impact: Improved personal branding and portfolio visits increased by 200%.

architecture.description: Single-page React application with Vite, deployed on Vercel.

title: E-commerce Platform
tagline: Full-stack e-commerce platform with payment integration
overview: A fully featured e-commerce web application supporting product listings, shopping cart, and Stripe payments.
problem: Need a platform to sell products online with secure payment handling.
solution: Developed a MERN stack application with Stripe integration for payments.
impact: Enabled small business owner to launch an online store within a week.

architecture.description: React frontend with Node.js/Express API and MongoDB.

title: Task Management App
tagline: Collaborative task management application with real-time updates
overview: A real-time task management tool built for teams to track progress with instant syncing.
problem: Teams needed a lightweight collaborative task tracker.
solution: Built using Firebase real-time database and React hooks.
impact: Improved team productivity by providing live updates.

architecture.description: Frontend in React, backend using Firebase.

title: Weather Dashboard
tagline: Real-time weather application with geolocation support
overview: Displays live weather data for any location using third-party APIs, plus historical trends.
problem: Users lacked a simple dashboard to see real-time weather info.
solution: Built a React app consuming OpenWeatherMap API with geolocation.
impact: Received positive feedback from early users, 500+ visits first week.

architecture.description: React frontend with third-party API calls.

title: Blog Engine
tagline: Markdown-based blog engine with SEO optimization
overview: Static site generator optimized for performance and search engine ranking, powered by MDX.
problem: Existing blog platforms lacked flexibility for custom features.
solution: Built own engine with MDX support and Tailwind for layout.
impact: Improved SEO rankings leading to a 50% increase in organic traffic.

architecture.description: Next.js based static site with MDX.
